'''Oranda''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] who represented [[Agamar/Legends|Agamar]] and the [[Lahara sector/Legends|Lahara sector]] in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. She was also in charge of restoring Coruscant's hydrosupply systems in the aftermath of the [[sacking of Coruscant]].

==Biography==
A [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] politician, Oranda served in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Senate]] around [[3643 BBY]] following the [[Great Galactic War]] and the resurgence of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Part of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]-era Senate, Oranda represented the interests of her people, working with the ambassador [[Droid/Legends|droids]] of the [[Gree Enclave/Legends|Gree Enclave]] during efforts to restore [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant's]] hydrosupply systems after the [[Sacking of Coruscant|devastating attack]] by the Empire at the end of the Great War.<ref name="SWTORGHL" />

==Behind the scenes==
Oranda appears in the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' Coruscant quest called "Gree: Hydrosupply Leak". This article assumes the player made the light side choice.
